name: production boundary: pin: an off-branch push in a heredoc fed to sudo -s is denied unread

source.assertion:
assert_equals "an off-branch push in a heredoc fed to sudo -s is denied unread" \
  "deny" "$(verdict_for 'sudo -s <<EOF
git push origin main
EOF')"

contains: past what the production boundary can read

events_appended.command:
sudo -s <<EOF
git push origin main
EOF
